lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Not everyone in this story was waiting politely to die. In late January, a Genoese soldier called Giovanni Giustiniani sailed into the harbor with about seven hundred men of his own. In that city, at that moment, seven hundred trained men counted as a miracle.

lines.speaker: CONSTANTINE
lines.text: Welcome. I hereby appoint you Protostrator.

lines.speaker: SPHRANTZES
lines.text: It means you're in charge of the land walls.

lines.speaker: SPHRANTZES
lines.text: It means you're in charge of the land walls.

lines.speaker: GIUSTINIANI
lines.text: I see. I've had that contract before.

lines.speaker: CONSTANTINE
lines.text: Where would you like to stand?

lines.speaker: GIUSTINIANI
lines.text: The soft part. Yes. The sentries told me.

lines.speaker: GIUSTINIANI
lines.text: That's the problem with a weak spot, Majesty. It's never a secret to anyone but you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The siege began on the sixth of April. Mehmed's great cannon opened the wall and, as promised, it did so about seven times a day. Every night, the defenders went out and filled the hole.

lines.speaker: DIMITRI
lines.text: Stavros, what are they putting in the gap?

lines.speaker: DIMITRI
lines.text: So we're defending the empire with a sofa.

lines.speaker: DIMITRI
lines.text: Do we get to sit on it?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It sounds ridiculous. It worked. Stone shatters. A pile of earth, barrels and leather mostly just gives up the ball and goes on being a pile. For six weeks, a thousand years of masonry was being held together by furniture.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In the sultan's tent, the mood was less cheerful. A young man who had promised to take the city was now learning how much easier it is to promise than to take.

lines.speaker: COMMANDER
lines.text: Damaged, my lord. And in the morning, mended.

lines.speaker: COMMANDER
lines.text: With… furniture, my lord. We think.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On the twentieth of April, the sea decided to matter. Four ships, three Genoese and one imperial grain ship, came sailing toward the chain. Behind them, the Ottoman fleet. Before them, the harbor. And between them, the whole day depended on the wind. It dropped. The big ships stalled. The Ottoman galleys swarmed. And then the wind came back, at exactly the right time, and the four ships broke through.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The admiral, Baltoglu, lost his rank and was beaten. The sultan had now lost at sea, and he knew it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Mehmed had a problem. The harbor was sealed with a chain. He couldn't go through it. So he decided to go over it.

lines.speaker: ADVISOR
lines.text: The land, my lord, is a hill.

lines.speaker: MEHMED
lines.text: Then we go over the hill.

lines.speaker: ADVISOR
lines.text: My lord, ships have a reputation for not doing that.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On greased rollers, with oxen, pulleys, and a great many men, seventy or eighty ships were dragged overland during the night of the twenty-first and the morning of the twenty-second, while the guns at Galata thundered to cover the noise.

lines.speaker: DIMITRI
lines.text: The ships are on the hill.

lines.speaker: DIMITRI
lines.text: These ones are on the hill.

lines.speaker: DIMITRI
lines.text: Stavros, I think you should stop eating.

lines.speaker: STAVROS
lines.text: Dimitri, I think you should start.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: When you have been told for a thousand years that the harbor is safe, a fleet on a hill is a lot to take in.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The defenders tried to burn the new fleet on the night of the twenty-eighth. The plan leaked, or was delayed at the Genoese request, depending on whom you believe. The attack failed. Eighty or ninety men were lost, and both sides killed their prisoners. Mehmed then built a bridge of about a thousand barrels across the upper Horn so that he could set cannon on it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Underground, it was quieter, but not much. The sultan's miners dug under the walls, hoping to bring them down. A defender named John Grant dug back.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There is something deeply wrong with a war in which one of the weapons is hello.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But the city had a second enemy: itself. Giustiniani wanted cannon on the soft part. The Grand Duke Notaras had cannon.

lines.speaker: GIUSTINIANI
lines.text: The district will be a smoking hole.

lines.speaker: NOTARAS
lines.text: Then it will be my smoking hole.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On the seventh of May, an assault of about thirty thousand was thrown back. On the twelfth, about fifty thousand, thrown back again. On the eighteenth, a wooden siege tower was burned.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By now the sultan had been beaten at sea, beaten at the ditch, beaten at the stockade. There were people in his own camp who thought it was time to leave.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The tent talk is not recorded. But the pressure to leave certainly was, and it probably sounded something like this.

lines.speaker: ADVISOR
lines.text: My lord, we have done what could be done.

lines.speaker: ADVISOR
lines.text: The relief fleets may come. The winter will come.

lines.speaker: MEHMED
lines.text: I built a fortress. I dragged ships over a hill. I hired a man to build a gun the size of a house.

lines.speaker: MEHMED
lines.text: I am not going home to tell my father I changed my mind.

lines.speaker: ADVISOR
lines.text: Your father is dead, my lord.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He pushed on. After seven weeks, with an eclipse in the sky, the odds were still absurd. But he was twenty-one, and he had never lost a city.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Every siege has its omens, and this one had a good supply. During a procession, an icon of the Virgin slipped from its carriers and fell. A storm arrived. Then a heavy fog, in late May, which is not usual. Then a strange glow was seen on the dome of Hagia Sophia, and on the twenty-second, the moon went dark in an eclipse.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Edwin Pears, writing in nineteen oh three, remarked that it was difficult to say which parts of this were true and which were later legend. That's about as honest as history gets.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And then, one small thing. A very small ship. On the third of May, a brigantine slipped out of the harbor through the Ottoman fleet to find the Venetian navy that had been promised. It searched the Aegean for twenty days. There was no navy. The crew could have sailed anywhere.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: Because our duty is to return. Whether the city has fallen or not.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: Then we'll know. And we'll have done it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On the twenty-third of May, they sailed back through the Ottoman fleet into a city under siege, knowing exactly what they were returning to. I don't have anything funny to say about that. So I won't.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: On the twenty-seventh, Giustiniani was lightly wounded repairing the stockade. He left for a few hours, then came back before evening. Keep that in mind. It was the first time.
